title: TUFT
description: Finally, a "working" Fletching Table! Seven. Years. Later.
body:
Aren't you exhausted of the Fletching Table _not working_ anymore?

Well no longer! Whenever you or a Villager attempts to use a Fletching Table, it... Does something! Maybe have one of your friends try it first.

<details>
<summary>Don't press this if you want to keep the interaction a surprise!</summary>

- It *explodes*, quite spectacularly too! So maybe stay away the first time? 

</details>

Full Disclosure: Do *not* install this mod in a world you care about or have a Trading Hall set in, or things will escalate very quickly.
